subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin/context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main partially addresses AGENTS.md bootstrap relevance and has plugin/context-engine compaction surfaces, but choosing a generic relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core requires maintainer architecture intent.

options.title: Split Into Tracks
options.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then repurpose this issue as the umbrella only if maintainers want that shape.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open only as a parent architecture discussion and continue blocking automated repair work until one track is prioritized.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm every remaining part is fully covered by narrower open items or belongs outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Tracks
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then repurpose this issue as the umbrella only if maintainers want that shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the prior maintainer-style review and has recent history on the affected bootstrap/runtime files.
